title: How to use DBT to generate materialized views in a target database that is different from the source database?
answer:
Use the PostgreSQL Connector to connect Trino to your PostgreSQL database directly instead of trying to create two targets in dbt. Presuming that you've created a catalog named postgres while still keeping your catalog cassandra intact, change the name of the catalog in your trino target to be postgres, delete the postgres target, and keep your sources as is.

That said, if you're only doing this to get around that error look into this response by MP24 first How to use DBT to generate materialized views in a target database that is different from the source database?
